source: Sandbox challenges, not race mark rounding rules. Each challenge has a `kind` that says how its steps are reached; the server detects them from its own boat state. Kinds: `visitBuoys`: one step per name in `buoys` (data/buoys.json), reached once the boat comes within proximityRadius of that buoy, any order, no rounding direction. A buoy may be a step of several challenges. `reward` is optional; the client unlocks it once the server reports the challenge complete.

challenges.title: Buoy tour
challenges.description: Sail within 30 m of every buoy in the bay, in any order.
